goal: A runtime verdict that produces the same decision as the integrator sessions without any model call.
why: Verdict work is deterministic; integrator sessions spend tokens on it.
acceptance: input: branch, sha, structured mutation list; output verdict/1
checks: head==sha, ancestry, allowed files, acceptance test identical and red on base, full suite, mutations killed, revert makes the test fail
a surviving mutation is cross-checked against the full suite before it counts
affected-test selection plus a cached full run per sha
read-only dry-run mode over past branches
constraints: spec only: Dev/Ops decide method and plan
